_note: LLM provider and limits. 'provider' can be overridden with env LLM_PROVIDER. Limits are per model and enforced client-side by agent/rate_limit.py.
_report_pipeline_note: 'single' (the tool-calling report agent, the baseline) or 'multi' (evidence agent -> writer -> verifier, run by agent/multi_agent.py). Env REPORT_PIPELINE overrides it. Multi needs an OpenAI-compatible provider; with gemini it runs as single (recorded in the trace and the result).

openai/gpt-oss-120b.source: rpd/tpm from Groq x-ratelimit-limit-* headers on this account (2026-10-18); rpm/tpd from console.groq.com/docs/rate-limits (not reported in headers)

openai/gpt-oss-20b.source: rpd/tpm from Groq x-ratelimit-limit-* headers on this account (2026-10-26); rpm/tpd from console.groq.com/docs/rate-limits (Developer plan table; same values as gpt-oss-120b, its own bucket)

qwen/qwen3.8-27b.source: rpd/tpm from Groq x-ratelimit-limit-* headers on this account (2026-10-18); rpm/tpd from console.groq.com/docs/rate-limits (not reported in headers); otpm 1000 from a 429 'Request too large ... output tokens per minute (OTPM): Limit 1000' on this account (2026-10-18; not in the docs table or headers). Groq checks max_completion_tokens against it up front.

openai/gpt-oss-120b._why_600: The rate limiter reserves this per call, so it sets how many calls fit in tpm. Measured completion tokens (output + reasoning): 21-238 per call (median 27; 23 llm_call spans of the 2026-10-25 demo runs) and 266-400 per whole report (216 eval reports). 600 = 2.5x the largest call, 1.5x the largest report. A reply cut off here (finish_reason length) is retried once, then the template is used.

openai/gpt-oss-20b._why: The multi-agent pipeline's verifier: one finding per claim plus low reasoning. The 2026-10-26 smoke run (n=3, 7-11 claims) used 745-895 completion tokens, too close to the first cap of 1000; 1600 leaves room for longer reports. It has its own Groq budget, so this only sizes the verifier's reservations.

qwen/qwen3.8-27b._why: instruct mode: with reasoning a judgement used ~1.2k output tokens, over the 1000 OTPM limit

_request_timeout_note: Async eval runner: a single LLM request (after rate-limit waits) is cancelled after this many seconds and treated as an infrastructure error (the run stops and can be resumed).

agents._note: Multi-agent pipeline: each agent's wall-clock limit (timeout_s, including rate-limit budget waits; a stage that runs past it falls back to the template; a report job's own deadline still applies on top) and request option overrides (request_options) on top of its model's.

request_options._why: Strict json_schema output plus low reasoning: a c35 draft used 584 completion tokens (266 reasoning + 318 JSON), and a 600 cap got Groq's 400 json_validate_failed 'max completion tokens reached' (2026-10-26 smoke run).
